title: Houston answers a question his mother asked only in her head

tellings.quote: question in my head without speaking and he answered the question that I had asked him in my head

plain: Houston Asher, a young man in Atlanta who does not speak, answered a question his mother had asked only in her head, without saying it out loud. His mother, Katie Asher, tells this as something she saw herself, in the documentary series The Telepathy Tapes, which Michels discusses with its maker, Ky Dickens. If true, it would mean Houston can read her thoughts.
